meta.nature: Static matching over publicly available central-sector agricultural schemes. No ML, no LLM - the app never invents a scheme or an application link.
meta.source_note: Descriptions and eligibility summaries are written from the official scheme portals listed in 'official_link'. Rules and crop coverage can change, so always confirm on the official portal before applying.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Direct income support of INR 6,000 per year paid in three equal instalments to eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.benefit: INR 6,000 per year as direct benefit transfer (DBT) into the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land in the farmer's name
Institutional landholders and income-tax payers are excluded
Aadhaar linked bank account is required for the instalment transfer

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance against yield loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases, at a low fixed premium for the farmer.
schemes.benefit: Claim payout for prevented sowing, standing crop loss and post-harvest losses; premium capped at 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial / horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers with valid documents
Enrolment through the bank (loanee farmers) or the PMFBY portal / CSC (non-loanee farmers)
Enrolment before the cut-off date of the season

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Short-term credit for crop cultivation, allied activities such as dairy and fisheries, and household needs linked to the farm.
schemes.benefit: Credit limit at a subsidised interest rate with interest subvention for prompt repayment; covers crop inputs and maintenance needs.
eligibility: Farmers with cultivable land (owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers)
Self-help groups and joint liability groups of farmers
Allied activity borrowers (poultry, dairy, fisheries)

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Gives every farmer a soil health card with the nutrient status of their field and crop-wise fertiliser recommendations every two years.
schemes.benefit: Laboratory soil test covering pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon and available N, P, K, S and micronutrients, plus crop-wise nutrient recommendations.
eligibility: All farmers with agricultural land (soil samples collected through the state agriculture department)
Samples are normally collected once every two years for the same plot

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop
schemes.description: Subsidy for micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler systems) to improve water use efficiency on the farm.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance (typically 45-55% of the system cost depending on the state and farmer category) for drip / sprinkler installation.
eligibility: Farmers with a reliable water source and an approved micro-irrigation design
Applications through the state agriculture / horticulture department or the state portal
Small, marginal and other farmers are eligible at different assistance rates

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) - Organic Farming
schemes.description: Promotes cluster based organic farming with training, certification support and assistance for on-farm inputs.
schemes.benefit: Assistance per hectare over the conversion cycle, free training and PGS-India organic certification support for the cluster.
eligibility: Farmers willing to join an organic cluster (cluster approach through the state)
Fields must be free of prohibited chemical inputs during the conversion period
Registration under PGS-India for participatory certification
required_documents: Cluster registration form from the state agriculture department

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.description: Support for horticulture development: planting material, protected cultivation (polyhouse / shade net), cold storage and post-harvest infrastructure.
schemes.benefit: Assistance for nurseries, protected cultivation, drip with mulch, precision farming and post-harvest management projects.
eligibility: Farmers growing fruits, vegetables, flowers, spices, coconut or other horticultural crops
Projects submitted through the state horticulture mission
Individual farmers, FPOs and cooperatives can apply
required_documents: Project proposal / quotation from an approved supplier

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.description: Medium to long term debt financing with interest subvention for post-harvest management and community farming assets.
schemes.benefit: Loan with 3% interest subvention up to INR 2 crore and credit guarantee cover for eligible projects (warehouses, cold storage, grading units).
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, agri-entrepreneurs and start-ups with a viable post-harvest project
Project financed by a scheduled bank / cooperative / NBFC under the scheme
Application through the AIF portal
required_documents: Land documents for the project site
